mechanism: Atazanavir is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase valbenazine and its active metabolite (NBI-98854) concentrations, potentially elevating QT prolongation and CNS adverse effects.
action: Monitor QTc interval and consider ECG baseline and periodic monitoring; assess for increased valbenazine-related adverse effects (akathisia, parkinsonism); consider dose reduction if excessive CNS or cardiac effects occur.
